title: This Bird Fights Venomous Snakes With Its Feet, and Wins
subject: secretary bird

scenes.text: This bird fights venomous snakes with its feet. And wins.
The secretary bird. About four feet tall, hunting on foot across the grass.
Scientists measured its kick on a hidden force plate. 195 newtons, about five times its body weight.
And it lasts just 15 milliseconds. A blink takes around 150.
It's too fast to correct mid-kick. If it misses, it just kicks again.
It stamps on the snake's head until the fight is over. One kick, one tenth of a blink.

description:
Secretary birds hunt venomous snakes on foot, stamping with a force of about five times their body weight.
Scientists measured 195 newtons in a single kick that lasted about 15 milliseconds, a tenth of a blink.
Would you want to be a snake near this bird?
first_comment: The study measured one captive bird using a rubber snake. What other animal's strike would you like measured?
